title: LSTM Time Series Forecasting for Stock Prices
description: Advanced deep learning model for predicting stock price movements using LSTM neural networks
shortDescription: Predicting stock market trends with LSTM neural networks
problem: Stock price prediction is a challenging problem in financial forecasting. Traditional statistical models often fail to capture complex non-linear patterns in market data. This project aimed to build a deep learning model that could learn temporal dependencies and predict future stock prices with higher accuracy than baseline models.
approach: I implemented a multi-layer LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) neural network architecture with attention mechanisms. The model was trained on 5 years of historical stock data, using a sliding window approach to create sequential training samples. I normalized the data using MinMax scaling and split it into 80% training and 20% testing sets.
methodologies: LSTM Architecture with 2 hidden layers (128 and 64 units)
Attention mechanism for temporal importance weighting
Sliding window of 60 days for sequence creation
keyFindings: LSTM models significantly outperformed ARIMA baseline (35% better RMSE)
Attention mechanisms improved directional accuracy by 8.5%
Model captures trend reversals better than traditional methods
Performance degrades slightly for predictions beyond 30 days

title: Customer Churn Prediction with Ensemble Methods
description: Predicting customer churn using ensemble machine learning techniques and feature engineering
shortDescription: Identifying at-risk customers with ensemble ML models
problem: A telecom company was experiencing 15-20% annual customer churn, leading to significant revenue loss. Predicting which customers are likely to churn would enable the company to implement targeted retention strategies. The challenge was to build an interpretable model that could identify key drivers of churn and provide actionable insights.
approach: I developed a comprehensive machine learning pipeline starting with exploratory data analysis and feature engineering. I created 45 new features from raw data including customer lifetime value, engagement metrics, and behavioral patterns. Multiple ensemble models (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, LightGBM) were trained and evaluated using cross-validation. SHAP values were used to explain model predictions.
methodologies: Feature engineering with domain knowledge (45 new features)
keyFindings: Top 3 churn drivers: contract type, monthly charges, and customer service calls
Customers with month-to-month contracts are 3x more likely to churn
Early intervention for customers with 4+ service calls improves retention by 35%
Model identifies 78.9% of actual churners while maintaining 82.3% precision

title: Multi-lingual Sentiment Analysis with Transformers
description: NLP project using transformer models for sentiment classification across multiple languages
shortDescription: Analyzing sentiment in multiple languages using BERT
problem: Process and analyze customer reviews in 5 different languages to gauge overall product sentiment
approach: Fine-tuned multilingual BERT model on custom dataset of 10,000 labeled reviews across English, Spanish, French, German, and Portuguese
keyFindings: Multilingual BERT outperforms language-specific models by 4.2%
User reviews show 73% positive sentiment overall

title: Medical Image Classification with Convolutional Neural Networks
description: Deep learning model for classifying chest X-rays and detecting anomalies
shortDescription: Detecting diseases in medical imaging with CNNs
problem: Assisting radiologists in detecting disease patterns in chest X-ray images
approach: Built a ResNet50-based CNN architecture with custom training procedures and data augmentation
keyFindings: Model achieves radiologist-level performance on subset of conditions
Data augmentation critical for medical imaging tasks

title: Market Basket Analysis for Retail Optimization
description: Association rule mining and product recommendation engine for e-commerce
shortDescription: Discovering product patterns to boost retail sales
problem: Optimize product placement and cross-sell strategies by understanding purchase patterns
approach: Applied Apriori algorithm to transaction data to find frequent itemsets and association rules
keyFindings: Discovered 8 high-confidence product bundles with lift > 3.0
Product bundle strategy increased average order value by 18%
Seasonal patterns identified in customer purchases
